content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Jacksonville

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific prerequisites—typically a secondary degree plus years of verifiable project leadership. Granite PM Academy staff can help you assess whether your background meets the credential's entry requirements before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Bootcamp, delivered by active certified practitioners. Attend instructor-led sessions from your home or office on a schedule that fits Jacksonville professionals balancing work and study. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and builds your exam readiness.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing the bootcamp, apply directly to PMI with your education and experience documentation. Pay PMI's examination fee to activate your candidacy. Granite PM Academy provides clear guidance on the application process and answers common questions so you submit a complete profile without delays.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to strengthen your readiness. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner at a time that works for you. Exam day confirms your mastery of project-management domains and framework.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP® operates on a three-year renewal cycle. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through ongoing training, certifications, and project work to renew your credential. Granite PM Academy offers continuing-education courses and resources to help you sustain and advance your certification throughout your career.
